```plato
// An axis-aligned bounding box in 3D
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Axis-aligned_bounding_box). Inclusive on Min and
// Max. An inverted box (Min greater than Max on any axis) is the EMPTY encoding:
// it contains no point and is the identity for Union, so accumulation can start
// from Empty(). Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Bounds.
type Bounds3D
    implements IBounds<Point3D, Vector3D>
{
    Min: Point3D;
    Max: Point3D;
}
```
